lines.text: 拖着东西的时候按 [key=rotate_item]，能转个方向

texts.en: Press [key=rotate_item] while dragging to turn it round.

lines.text: 按住 [key=hide_tip]，道具的说明先藏起来，松开又回来

texts.en: Hold [key=hide_tip] to hide item descriptions; let go and they're back.

lines.text: 按住 [key=whole_bag] 再拖，整个包连里面的东西一起走

texts.en: Hold [key=whole_bag] and drag to move a whole bag with everything in it.
